summary.en: Yuhan combines lung-cancer lifecycle development with allergy, metabolic and oncology candidates. Its pipeline includes several early clinical programmes and externally sourced innovation.
summary.zh: Yuhan将肺癌生命周期开发与过敏、代谢和肿瘤候选药物相结合。其管线包括多个早期临床项目和外部引入的创新。

gaps: Company-wide counts by phase were not verified; counts is null. Unverified codes, mechanisms, modalities, origins and milestone dates are null rather than inferred.

The mobile page contains inconsistent stage labels for YH35324 and YH34160. The report verifies YH35324 as Phase 2; YH34160 is omitted because its current clinical status was not resolved. YH25724 and YH35995 are not promoted beyond the verified Phase 1 descriptions.

The sustainability report pipeline snapshot is May 2026, older than June 2026. YH32364 is Phase 1 on the current pipeline, which takes precedence over the older Phase 1/2 report. YH32367 remains a combined Phase 1/2 study represented as 2.

YH25724 is Phase 1 on the current mobile pipeline despite Phase 2 in the May report; Phase 1 is retained conservatively. YH42946 remains Phase 1 because September guidance places dose expansion in early 2027.
Origins remain unverified for YH14618, YH12852, YH32367, YH32364 and YH35995; YH14618 modality and most next milestones remain null. The 2023 GI Innovation release establishes provenance only.
